dataset.name: texa-ecommerce-workflow-challenge-v1-candidate

coverage_edge.perturbation: one purchase row removed from each source

dataset.fixture_policy: Synthetic challenge-only rows registered under the two catalog source IDs; apply only in an isolated benchmark database. The Olist fixture's device/campaign values are synthetic challenge capabilities, not claims about real Olist data. One event_activity row is one event; Olist purchase event rows model item lines, and payment rows are separate non-purchase events.
dataset.metric_policy: events counts rows; users/sessions/viewers/buyers are distinct IDs; viewers require view; buyers require purchase; purchases count purchase rows (item-line grain); revenue sums purchase revenue only and empty sum is zero; buyer_conversion_rate is distinct buyers / distinct observed users, NULL for zero denominator. Group domains contain eligible observed events; ratio groups retain rows supported by numerator OR denominator population, so a legitimate zero numerator is retained. Missing/NULL nested scalars do not match filters. No inferred calendar rows.
dataset.coverage_gap: This is a coherent provisional candidate, not the planned 180 single / 24 clarification / 24 dialogue suite. Counts and source/language quotas are below design targets; no human review or holdout seal.
